options.name: cwd
options.description: Run as if spice was started in <dir> instead of the current directory.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install one or more packages and add them to the manifest. With no arguments, installs everything declared in the manifest.

arguments.name: packages
arguments.description: One or more packages to install.

options.name: exact
options.description: Pin an exact version instead of a semver range.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove one or more packages from the manifest.

arguments.name: packages
arguments.description: One or more packages to remove.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a script defined in the manifest.

arguments.name: script
arguments.description: Name of the script to run.

options.name: if-present
options.description: Exit gracefully (status 0) when the script is missing.
